90:1.ar: أقسم الله بالبلد الحرام الذي هو مكة المكرمة.
90:1.en: Allah takes an oath on the sacred city i.e. Makkah Al-Mukarramah

90:2.ar: وأنت - أيها الرسول - حلال لك ما تصنع فيها؛ من قَتْل مَنْ يستحق القتل، وأَسْر من يستحقّ الأسر.
90:2.en: O Messenger! It is permissible for you to do whatever you wish on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah, from capital punishment to those whom are deserving of it, to taking captive whomsoever deserves it.

90:3.ar: وأقسم الله بوالد البشر، وأقسم بما تناسل منه من الولد.
90:3.en: And Allah takes an oath on the father of humanity, also taking an oath on the offspring reproduced from him.

90:4.ar: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في تعب ومشقة؛ لما يعانيه من الشدائد في الدنيا.
90:4.en: Verily, I have created the human in tiredness and difficulty, because of the severities he experiences in the world.

90:5.ar: أيظنّ الإنسان أنه إذا اقترف المعاصي لا يقدر عليه أحد، ولا ينتقم منه، ولو كان ربه الذي خلقه؟!
90:5.en: Does the human think that when he sins, no one is in a position to be able to do anything to him, nor take retribution from him, even if it is his Lord who created him?

90:6.ar: يقول: أنفقت مالًا كثيرًا متراكمًا بعضه فوق بعض.
90:6.en: He says: “I spent a lot of wealth, heaped up.”

90:7.ar: أيظنّ هذا المتباهي بما ينفقه أن الله لا يراه؟! وأنه لا يحاسبه في ماله؛ من أين اكتسبه؟ وفيم أنفقه؟!
90:7.en: Does this person boastful over the wealth he has spent think that Allah does not see him? And that He will not take him to account over his wealth: how he earned it and where he spent it?

90:8.ar: ألم نجعل له عينين يبصر بهما؟!
90:8.en: Did I not create eyes for him with which he can see?

90:9.en: And a tongue and lips with which he can speak?

90:10.en: And I made the paths of goodness and evils known to him.

90:11.ar: وهو مطالب بأن يتجاوز العقبة التي تفصله عن الجنة فيقطعها ويتجاوزها.
90:11.en: He will be required to cross the valley that separates him from Paradise, which he will cross.

90:12.ar: وما أعلمك - أيها الرسول - ما العقبة التي عليه أن يقطعها ليدخل الجنة؟!
90:12.en: O Messenger! Do you know what the valley is that he has to cross, in order to enter Paradise?

90:13.ar: هي إعتاق رقبة ذكرًا كانت أو أنثى.
90:13.en: It is to free a male or female slave.

90:14.ar: أو أن يطعم في يوم مجاعة يندر فيه وجود الطعام.
90:14.en: Or to feed on a day of drought, in which food is scarce.

90:15.ar: طفلًا فقد أباه، له به قرابة.
90:15.en: A child who has lost his father, whom he is related to.

90:16.ar: أو فقيرًا ليس له شيء يملكه.
90:16.en: Or a poor person who has no possessions.

90:17.ar: ثم كان من الذين آمنوا بالله، وأوصى بعضهم بعضًا بالصبر على الطاعات وعن المعاصي وعلى البلاء، وأوصى بعضهم بعضًا بالرحمة بعباد الله.
90:17.en: Then he is required to be from those who have faith in Allah and advise each other to remain steadfast on act of obedience and refraining from sins, and bearing patience over difficulties, together with advising one another to show mercy to the servants of Allah.

90:18.ar: أولئك المتصفون بتلك الصفات هم أصحاب اليمين.
90:18.en: Those are the people of the right.

90:19.ar: والذين كفروا بآياتنا المنزلة على رسولنا هم أصحاب الشمال.
90:19.en: As for those who disbelieve in My verses that were revealed to My Messenger, they are the people of the left.

90:20.ar: عليهم نار مغلقة يوم القيامة يعذبون فيها.
90:20.en: A closed fire will be set upon them on the Day of Judgement, with which they will be punished.

91:1.ar: أقسم الله بالشمس، وأقسم بوقت ارتفاعها بعد طلوعها من مشرقها.
91:1.en: Allah takes an oath on the sun and its rising after breaking onto the eastern horizon.

91:2.ar: وأقسم بالقمر إذا تبع أثرها بعد غروبها.
91:2.en: He also takes an oath on the moon when it follows the sun after it has set.

91:3.ar: وأقسم بالنهار إذا كشف ما على وجه الأرض بضوئه.
91:3.en: Allah also takes an oath on the day when it reveals whatever is on the face of the earth through its light.

91:4.ar: وأقسم بالليل إذا يغشى وجه الأرض، فيصير مظلمًا.
91:4.en: And He also takes an oath on the night when it covers the face of the earth, darkening it.

91:5.en: And He takes an oath on the sky, taking an oath on its perfect creation.

91:6.ar: وأقسم بالأرض، وأقسم ببسطها؛ ليسكن الناس عليها.
91:6.en: He also takes an oath on the earth: the way it has been spread so that people can live on it.

91:7.ar: وأقسم بكل نفس، وأقسم بخلق الله لها سوية.
91:7.en: He also takes an oath on each soul, with Allah having created it equally.

91:8.ar: فأفهمها من غير تعليم ما هو شرّ لتجتنبه، وما هو خير لتأتيه.
91:8.en: Then He made it understand - without teaching it - what was evil so it could be abstained from, and what was good so it could be implemented.

91:9.ar: قد فاز بمطلوبه من طهّر نفسه بتحليتها بالفضائل، وتخليتها عن الرذائل.
91:9.en: Verily, the one who has purified his soul by adorning it with virtuous characteristics and freeing it from evil traits, has succeeded.

91:10.ar: وقد خسر من دَسَّ نفسه مخفيًا إياها في المعاصي والآثام.
91:10.en: And verily the one who has secretly thrust his soul into sins and disobedience, has lost.

91:11.ar: كذبت ثمود نبيها صالحًا بسبب مجاوزتها الحدّ في ارتكاب المعاصي، واقتراف الآثام.
91:11.en: After Allah mentions the loss of the one who thrust his soul secretly into sins, He mentions the Thamūd as an example of that, saying: The Thamūd rejected their Prophet Saleh due to their transgressing the limits in committing sins and disobedience.

91:12.ar: حين قام أشقاهم بعد انتداب قومه له.
91:12.en: When the most wretched among them stood up after his people has appointed him for the task.

91:13.ar: فقال لهم رسول الله صالح عليه السلام: اتركوا ناقة الله، وشِرْبها في يومها، فلا تتعرضوا لها بسوء.
91:13.en: The Messenger of Allah Saleh (peace be upon him) said to them: “Leave the camel of Allah alone; let it drink on its day and do not pursue it intending evil.”

91:14.ar: فكذبوا رسولهم في شأن الناقة، فقتلها أشقاهم مع رضاهم بما فعل، فكانوا شركاء في الإثم، فأطبق الله عليهم عذابه، فأهلكهم بالصيحة بسبب ذنوبهم، وسوّاهم في العقوبة التي أهلكهم بها.
91:14.en: But they rejected their Messenger with regards to the camel, and so the most wretched among them killed it with the consent of his people. Therefore, they were all guilty of the crime and so Allah enveloped them into His punishment and destroyed them by a shriek due to their sins. He made them equal in the punishment that He destroyed them with.

91:15.ar: فعل الله بهم من العذاب ما أهلكهم غير خائف سبحانه من تبعاته.
91:15.en: Allah set the punishment that destroyed them, upon them, without Him, may He be glorified, fearing any reproach over His actions.

92:1.ar: أقسم الله بالليل إذا يغطي ما بين السماء والأرض بظلمته.
92:1.en: Allah takes an oath on the night when it covers whatever is between the heavens and the earth with its darkness.

92:2.en: And Allah takes an oath on the day when it becomes clear and visible.

92:3.en: And He takes an oath on His creating the two genders: The male and female.

92:4.ar: إن عملكم - أيها الناس - لمختلف، فمنه الحسنات التي هي سبب دخول الجنة، والسيئات التي هي سبب دخول النار.
92:4.en: O people! Your actions are different: some are good, which are the causes of entering Paradise, while others are evil, which are the causes of entering the hellfire.

92:5.ar: فأما من أعطى ما يلزمه بذله؛ من زكاة ونفقة وكفارة، واتقى ما نهى الله عنه.
92:5.en: As for the one who gives whatever is necessary for him to spend, i.e. Zakat, financial support and repatriation, and is mindful of that which Allah has prohibited him from.

92:6.ar: وصدَّق بما وعده الله به من الخَلَف.
92:6.en: And he believes in the substitute Allah has promised him.

92:7.ar: فسنُسَهِّل عليه العمل الصالح، والإنفاق في سبيل الله.
92:7.en: I shall soon make performing good deeds and spending in My path easy for him.

92:8.ar: وأما من بخل بماله فلم يبذله فيما يجب عليه بذله فيه، واستغنى بماله عن الله فلم يسأل الله من فضله شيئًا.
92:8.en: And as for the one who is miserly with his wealth and does not spend it in the avenues necessary for him to spend in, thinking himself to be in no need of Allah and not asking Allah for any of His grace.

92:9.ar: وكذَّب بما وعده الله من الخَلَف ومن الثواب على إنفاق ماله في سبيل الله.
92:9.en: Whilst rejecting the substitute and reward Allah has promised him if he spends his wealth in His path.

92:10.ar: فسنُسَهِّل عليه عمل الشرّ، ونُعَسِّر عليه فعل الخير.
92:10.en: I will soon make performing evil deeds easy for him, and make difficult doing good.

92:11.ar: وما يغني عنه ماله الذي بخل به شيئًا إذا هلك، ودخل النار.
92:11.en: His wealth that he is miserly with will not benefit him at all when he dies and enters the hellfire.

92:12.ar: إن علينا أن نبيّن طريق الحق من الباطل.
92:12.en: Indeed, it is My responsibility to make the path of truth clear from the path of falsehood.

92:13.ar: وإن لنا لَلْحياة الآخرة ولنا الحياة الدنيا، نتصرّف فيهما بما نشاء، وليس ذلك لأحد غيرنا.
92:13.en: And indeed, the afterlife and the worldly life belongs to Me; I do whatever I want with it. That is not the case with anyone else.

92:14.ar: فحذّرتكم - أيها الناس - من نار تتوقد إن أنتم عصيتم الله.
92:14.en: So O people! If you disobey Me, I warn you of the hellfire which is being kindled.

92:15.ar: لا يقاسي حرّ هذه النار إلا الأشقى وهو الكافر.
92:15.en: None will suffer the heat of this fire except the most wretched, i.e. the disbeliever.

92:16.ar: الذي كذَّب بما جاء به الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأعرض عن امتثال أمر الله.
92:16.en: The one who rejected whatever the Messenger (peace be upon him) brought, and turned away from fulfilling the command of Allah.

92:17.ar: وسيُباعَد عنها أتقى الناس أبو بكر رضي الله عنه.
92:17.en: The most Allah-conscious of the people will be distanced from it, i.e. Abu Bakr.

92:18.ar: الذي ينفق ماله في وجوه البر ليتطهر من الذنوب.
92:18.en: The one who spends his wealth in righteous avenues, to purify himself of sins.

92:19.ar: ولا يبذل ما يبذل من ماله ليكافئ نعمة أنعم بها أحد عليه.
92:19.en: He does not spend whatever wealth he spends, to repay any favour done to him by anyone.

92:20.ar: لا يريد بما يبذله من ماله إلا وجه ربه العالي على خَلْقِه.
92:20.en: Through his spending, he only intends the pleasure of his Lord who is High above His creation.

92:21.ar: ولسوف يرضى بما يعطيه الله من الجزاء الكريم.
92:21.en: And indeed, soon, he will be pleased with the generous reward Allah will grant him.

93:1.en: Allah takes an oath on the beginning of the day.

93:2.ar: وأقسم بالليل إذا أظلم وسكن الناس فيه عن الحركة.
93:2.en: And He takes an oath on the night when it darkens and people cease to move in it.

93:3.ar: ما تركك - أيها الرسول - ربك، وما أبغضك؛ كما يقول المشركون لما فَتَر الوحي.
93:3.en: O Messenger! Your Lord has not left you, nor has he begun to hate you, as the idolaters claimed when there was a break in the revelation.

93:4.ar: ولَلدار الآخرة خير لك من الدنيا؛ لما فيها من النعيم الدائم الذي لا ينقطع.
93:4.en: Indeed, the abode of the afterlife is better for you than the worldly one, because of the everlasting bounties that it has.

93:5.ar: ولسوف يعطيك من الثواب الجزيل لك ولأمتك حتى ترضى بما أعطاك وأعطى أمتك.
93:5.en: Very soon He will grant you an abundant reward, and your nation also, until you become content with what He has granted you and your nation.

93:6.ar: لقد وجدك صغيرًا قد مات عنك أبوك، فجعل لك مأوى، حيث عطف عليك جدُّك عبد المطلب، ثم عمّك أبو طالب.
93:6.en: Verily, He found you at a time when you were a child whose father had passed away, and so He made a place of refuge for you by causing your grandfather Abdul Muttalib to become fond of you, and then your uncle Abu Talib.

93:7.ar: ووجدك لا تدري ما الكتاب ولا الإيمان، فعلّمك من ذلك ما لم تكن تعلم.
93:7.en: He found you in a state where you did not know what revelation or faith was, and so He taught you about that which you did not know.

93:8.en: And He found you poor, so He made you self-sufficient.

93:9.ar: فلا تُسِئ معاملة من فقد أباه في الصغر، ولا تذلّه.
93:9.en: Therefore, do not treat badly the one who has lost his father in childhood, nor look down upon him.

93:10.en: And do not rebuke the needy beggar.

93:11.ar: واشكر نِعَم الله عليك وتحدث بها.
93:11.en: And be grateful for the favours of Allah upon you, and talk about them.
